reason: We moved off E-Golf4U less than a year ago and the volunteers and members are only just used to the new system; even a free pilot means another round of explaining, and I can't sell the board a second switch now, especially to two founders with no club live yet.
objection: Two founders and a product nobody runs yet: 12 months' notice and a spreadsheet export are fine on paper, but if they stop we migrate again, and I'm not putting 950 members through that twice.
would_change_my_mind: In about two years, a handful of comparable 18-hole clubs running it for a full season whose boards I can call, and proof the team has grown beyond two people.
